title: 🛠️ React component using hooks and fetching data for displaying chat sessions with different colors based on role.

messages.content: This is a React component that displays a list of chat sessions using the `Ionic` library. It uses the `useEffect` hook to fetch data from an API and update the state with the received data. The component also defines a helper function called `colorForRole` which returns a color based on the role of the user in the chat session.
